info.title: Soumit Public API
info.summary: Programmatic access to public procurement tenders, analyses, Go/No-Go verdicts and award history.
info.description:
## Honesty contract

A field this API cannot establish is `null`, and the reason is in the resource's
`unavailable` map as a stable code. Nothing is ever filled with a plausible substitute:
a tender with no published budget has `budget.amount: null`, not a guess; a catalogue
item with no recorded cost has `margin_percent: null`, not a default rate; a Go/No-Go
factor with no input has `status: "unknown"` and `value: null`, and its weight leaves
the denominator so it neither helps nor hurts.

Analyses carry a `quality.tier` — `decision_ready`, `review_required` or `degraded` —
and per-field provenance, so a consumer can tell a solid answer from a weak one instead
of treating every response as equally trustworthy.

## Tenancy

An API key belongs to exactly one organisation and there is no parameter that can change
which. The tender corpus and the award history are shared public data and are identical
for every customer. Everything else — analyses, verdicts, pursuits, catalogue, documents,
events, webhooks — is private to your organisation.

## Pagination

Cursor-based. Read `next_cursor` and pass it back as `cursor`. Page size defaults to 25 and
caps at 100. Cursors are opaque; do not parse them.

## Rate limits

Per API key, per hour: 1000 reads and 300 writes by default.
Every response carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`; a 429
states the limit and the reset instant in its body as well.

## Idempotency

Send `Idempotency-Key` on writes. The same key with the same body replays the first
response; the same key with a different body is a 409.

## Webhooks

Deliveries POST the event resource and sign it: `X-Soumit-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>`,
where the MAC is HMAC-SHA256 over `"<t>.<raw body>"` with your endpoint's signing secret.
Reject a delivery whose `t` is more than five minutes from your clock, and deduplicate on
`X-Soumit-Event-Id`: delivery is at-least-once. Failed deliveries are retried 6
times with backoff (60s, 300s, 1800s, 7200s, 21600s, 86400s), and every attempt is recorded and
readable from `/api/v1/webhook-deliveries`.

get.description: The shared public procurement corpus, newest publication first. Every tender is visible to every tenant — marchespublics.gov.ma publishes it — but the per-tender `relevance` block is computed from *your* organisation's overlay only. `relevance=engaged` narrows the list to tenders your organisation has analysed, put on a pursuit board, or watchlisted.

parameters.description: `all` (default) returns the whole corpus; `engaged` returns only tenders your organisation has an analysis, pursuit or watchlist row for.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter on the published tender status, matched case-insensitively.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Filter on the published region string, matched case-insensitively.

parameters.name: deadline_after
parameters.description: ISO 8601 date. Only tenders whose deadline is on or after this date. Tenders with no published deadline are excluded by this filter, never assumed open.

parameters.name: deadline_before
parameters.description: ISO 8601 date. Only tenders whose deadline is on or before this date.

parameters.name: published_after
parameters.description: ISO 8601 date-time. Only tenders published (or, failing that, first seen) at or after this instant.

parameters.description: Page size, 1..100. Defaults to 25. A larger value is an error, not a silent clamp.
